_notes: Virtual machine registry for the virtual console (port 8878).
Each entry mirrors the real configs/machines.json schema (machine, modes,
logicClassNames, configSummaryMd5, codeSummaryMd5, available) so the
existing frontend + backend treat these as normal machines.
metadata used by slot_designer/backend/virtual_analyzer.py to locate the
spec + weights for each virtual machine. The real backend ignores
MD5s are auto-refreshed by virtual_app.build_virtual_app() on startup
AND by the virtual console's POST /api/machines/refresh-md5 (which is
overridden to compute md5 locally from spec + weights + engine source).
NEVER fetches from upstream — this registry stays isolated from real
fleet (historical bug 2026-04-21: upstream refresh pulled 253 real
machines into here; fix is the create_app md5_refresh_override hook).
